description: Public company and market data from SEC filings and live quotes (Yahoo): company snapshots and fundamentals, stock screens, investor portfolios from Form 13F, and US House member trades.

action.description: Which operation to run. snapshot = current quote and key metrics of one company, needs ticker; fundamentals = SEC fundamentals of one company over time, needs ticker; screen = daily stock screens by growth, value, range or moving average; investors = the investors whose Form 13F autario reads; investor_portfolio = one investor's holdings and moves for a quarter, needs investor; who_holds = which tracked investors hold a company, needs ticker; politicians = US House members with reported trades; politician_trades = one member's reported stock trades, needs politician; congress_trades = US House trades in one stock, needs ticker.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the newest daily snapshot on or before this day (for backtests). Default: the newest.

filters.description: Column ranges, e.g. {"net_margin":{"min":10},"pct_vs_200w_ma":{"max":-20}}. A row without the column is excluded.

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

interval.description: Row spacing: the value known on the last trading day of each period. Default quarterly (token-efficient); daily for a backtest.

investor.description: Investor slug from markets action "investors" (e.g. berkshire-hathaway, scion-asset-management), its display name, or its SEC CIK.

limit.description: screen: Rows to return (default 25, max 200) investor_portfolio: Max holdings returned, largest first (default 500, max 5000). politician_trades, congress_trades: Max trades returned, newest first (default 200, max 2000).

metrics.description: snapshot: Metrics to return: price metrics (price, open, high, low, volume, perf_1d, perf_1w, perf_1m, perf_3m, perf_1y, perf_ytd, latest_date) and/or fundamental metric keys (e.g. revenue, roe, price-to-book, dividend-yield, revenue-growth-5y) or fundamentals for every fundamental row. If omitted, returns price + perf_1d + perf_ytd. fundamentals: Fields to return (see the list above). Default: close, adj_close, revenue, net_income, eps_diluted.

politician.description: Slug from markets action "politicians" (josh-gottheimer-nj) or a full or last name that matches exactly one member.

preset.description: growth | profitability | value | near-52-week-high | near-52-week-low | below-200-week-ma | most-held-by-13f

quarter.description: Quarter end date (2026-06-30) or label (2026-Q2). Omit for the latest reported quarter.

sort.description: Column to order by (default: the rank column of the preset)

ticker.description: snapshot: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, INTC, NVDA, SAP, BMW fundamentals: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, KO who_holds: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, KO, GOOGL congress_trades: Stock ticker, e.g. NVDA, AAPL, MSFT

window.description: fundamentals: Time window: 1y, 3y, 5y, 10y, max, or from:to as YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD (either side may be empty). Default 5y. politician_trades: 30d | 90d | 1y | 2y | all (default 1y), by transaction date. congress_trades: 30d | 90d | 1y | 2y | all (default 1y).

name: markets
